{{Quote|Don't get caught, Hosk. Don't remember me if you do.|The M'shento'su'Nikto|<ref name="Leg2" />}}
A '''M'shento'su'Nikto''' owed<ref name="Leg2" /> the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Hosk Trey'lis]] a favor by around [[137 ABY]]. At that [[Time/Legends|time]], Trey'lis asked the [[M'shento'su'Nikto]] to help him get off the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. Once they made the necessary arrangements, the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] met the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the establishment<ref name="Leg2" /> [[Brogar's Safe House and Cantina]].<ref name="LECG" /> They told Trey'lis that everything had been arranged and to be at [[Pad 9]] in an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]]. When the Bothan thanked them for their help, the Nikto reminded Trey'lis that they owed him a favor and instructed him to not get caught, or to forget them in the case he was captured. Shortly afterward, Trey'lis was apprehended by a trio of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. The Nikto had [[Color/Legends|orange]] skin and wore a black [[Robe/Legends|robe]] with a green hood.<ref name="Leg2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The M'shento'su'Nikto appeared in the [[Legacy (2006) 2|second issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' comic series. The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]] and [[Jan Duursema]], illustrated by Duursema, and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Leg2" /> on [[July 11]], [[2006]].<ref name="Date">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54720/star_wars_legacy_2006_2|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 2}}</ref>
